Paragraph 1: Rajadamnern Knockout brings fast three-round fights to one of Bangkok’s historic Muay Thai stadiums. Thai fighters meet international challengers in a high-energy evening that is easy to follow, even if this is your first live Muay Thai event.
Paragraph 2: Each event usually features seven three-round bouts, with knees, elbows and clinching under Muay Thai rules. Rajadamnern promotes the series around an advertised 80% knockout rate.

H2: New to Muay Thai? You are in the right place.
Body: You do not need to understand scoring, fighter rankings or stadium traditions before you arrive. The three-round format is easy to follow, and the action starts from the opening bell.

Card 2 body: See Wai Kru and hear live traditional music.

H2: What to expect at Rajadamnern Knockout
Paragraph 1: Rajadamnern Knockout combines modern three-round competition with the traditions that make Muay Thai unique.
Paragraph 2: Expect Wai Kru before the bouts, live traditional Muay Thai music, knees, elbows and clinching under Muay Thai rules, plus Thai fighters and international challengers competing inside Rajadamnern Stadium.
Paragraph 3: There is usually an interval around 8:00 pm, followed by the Rajadamnern Immersive Dome Experience at around 8:10 pm.
Operational note: Fights start on time. Fight cards and later running times can change.

Body: After the interval, the stadium roof becomes an immersive visual show celebrating Muay Thai history and culture. It usually begins at around 8:10 pm.
